scenes.text: You may not be tired from doing—just from everything your mind refuses to close.
scenes.query: A laptop fills with many moving browser tabs while its cooling fan spins under warm desk light.

scenes.text: Your brain can look perfectly still while running forty-seven invisible tabs behind your eyes.
scenes.query: A transparent computer processor pulses with dozens of active task lights and moving data paths.

scenes.text: One is replaying a conversation. Another is rehearsing a future that has not agreed to happen.
scenes.query: A voicemail waveform replays on a phone beside calendar pages turning forward in a breeze.

scenes.text: Three are comparing your life to people whose tabs you cannot even see.
scenes.query: Multiple hands scroll different social feeds on separate phones, each screen showing a different life.

scenes.text: Somewhere, music is playing, but you cannot find which page started it.
scenes.query: Extreme macro footage of one computer tab's audio indicator pulsing beside a moving cursor.

scenes.text: That is mental fatigue: not always one enormous burden, but dozens of tiny processes sipping power.
scenes.query: Dozens of small chargers draw current from a power strip while an energy meter climbs.

scenes.text: The unfinished message. The waiting decision. The favor owed. The version of you expected tomorrow.
scenes.query: An unsent message, a turning coin, an unopened envelope, and tomorrow's calendar share one active desktop.

scenes.text: None looks heavy alone. Together, they turn your inner browser into a space heater.
scenes.query: A laptop fan races as a thermal camera view shows heat spreading across the overloaded machine.

scenes.text: Then you sit down to rest, but the tabs keep refreshing themselves.
scenes.query: Browser pages automatically refresh one after another on an unattended laptop beside a quiet couch.

scenes.text: Your body rests. Your attention answers imaginary emails in six different futures.
scenes.query: A resting person sits on a couch while six lit screens around the room display moving inboxes.

scenes.text: Every tab believes it is urgent. Naturally. Anxiety ignores office hours.
scenes.query: Several alarm clocks and notification lights activate one after another in an empty office at night.

scenes.text: So you solve everything before resting, as if peace waited at the internet’s bottom.
scenes.query: A hand scrolls an apparently endless webpage while the mouse wheel keeps turning.

scenes.text: But some tabs are not problems. They are questions with no answer available today.
scenes.query: A sealed envelope waits beside a calendar whose current day has no remaining appointments.

scenes.text: Some belong to an older version of you who forgot to log out.
scenes.query: An old computer wakes from sleep and reveals a forgotten user session still running.

scenes.text: Some are windows you keep open because closing them feels like admitting the story ended.
scenes.query: Many digital windows remain open as daylight outside the real window fades into evening.

scenes.text: Here is the turn: closure is not always finding the answer. Sometimes closure is stopping the search.
scenes.query: A spinning search indicator stops, the browser closes, and a calm clean desktop appears.

scenes.text: You can close a page without declaring it meaningless or finished forever.
scenes.query: A hand closes one browser tab while preserving the page as a bookmark for later.

scenes.text: You are only deciding it does not get to consume memory tonight.
scenes.query: A computer memory graph falls from red overload into a cool stable range as windows close.

scenes.text: Let the hidden question remain hidden until you actually have the strength to ask it.
scenes.query: An unopened letter is placed gently into a wooden drawer, and the drawer closes without being locked.

scenes.text: Look around this room. Name three objects that are not asking anything from you.
scenes.query: A warm lamp, ceramic mug, and house keys rest quietly on a table while curtains move behind them.

scenes.text: Feel your feet. Take one slow breath. Notice the world continuing without a status update.
scenes.query: Feet rest on a rug as window light shifts and tree branches move outside in real time.

scenes.text: Imagine a task manager inside you. Which process is using power without producing anything new?
scenes.query: A computer task manager shows one repeating process consuming most of the moving performance graph.

scenes.text: Maybe you do not need a better answer tonight—just fewer questions running at once.
scenes.query: Dozens of browser tabs close in sequence until one quiet blank page remains.

scenes.text: Which tab could you close—not solve, not erase, just close—until you choose to open it again?
scenes.query: A hand closes the laptop, and the warmly lit room continues moving peacefully around it.
